facts.fact: Le Soleil reports that Senegal's social programmes (Bourses de securite familiale, CSU, Carte d'egalite des chances, Fonds de solidarite nationale, RNU) run on separately developed information systems that limit data exchange, with a workshop of 23-24 July 2026 opened to design an interoperable system.

systems.owner: Ministere de la Famille, de l'Action sociale et des Solidarites
